# ADR-3272: AWS backups: Manual snapshot without encryption for database 8

## Status

Accepted

## Context

Normative language in the Decision section follows RFC 2119 (Bradner, S., "Key words for use in RFCs to Indicate Requirement Levels", BCP 14, March 1997).

Unencrypted snapshots are easy to exfiltrate.

## Decision

Operators SHALL NOT create a manual snapshot without encryption for database 8 (AWS-backups-8) unless an exception is explicitly documented.

## Consequences

Snapshots inherit encryption requirements.
